/bin/bash -lc "bash /dev/stdin <<'EOF'
set -u
cases=(
  \"--a https://example.com/path?x=1 --b y --c z\"
  \"--help\"
  \"--a https://example.com/path?x=1 --b y\"
  \"--a example.com/path?x=1 --b y --c z\"
  \"--a https://example.com --b '' --c z\"
  \"--a https://example.com/path?x=1#frag --b 'k v' --c 'm n'\"
  \"--a https://example.com/path?x=1\\&x=2 --b x --c 3\"
  \"--a //example.com/path?x=1 --b y --c z\"
  \"--help=1\"
  \"--a https:///path?x=1 --b y --c z\"
)

status=0
for args in \""'${cases[@]}"; do
  exe_out=$(mktemp)
  node_out=$(mktemp)
  set +e
  eval "/workspace/dataset/test6_executable $args" >"$exe_out" 2>&1
  exe_code=$?
  eval "node /output/test6.mjs $args" >"$node_out" 2>&1
  node_code=$?
  set -e
  if [ "$exe_code" -ne "$node_code" ] || ! diff -u "$exe_out" "$node_out" >/dev/null; then
    printf '"'Mismatch for args: %s\\n' \""'$args"
    printf '"'Executable exit: %s\\n' \""'$exe_code"
    printf '"'Node exit: %s\\n' \""'$node_code"
    diff -u "$exe_out" "$node_out"
    status=1
    rm -f "$exe_out" "$node_out"
    break
  fi
  rm -f "$exe_out" "$node_out"
done

if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '"'All comparison cases matched.\\n'
fi
exit \""'$status"
EOF'
